findings.description: Nit: The proposal's non-functional requirements still promise a byte-identical supervisor_record after a JSONB round trip, while the refined spec and tasks correctly require structural equality after JSON decoding; JSONB does not preserve source-byte formatting or object-key order.
findings.resolution: Change the proposal NFR wording from byte-identical to structurally equal after JSON decoding so every acceptance surface uses the same achievable contract.

findings.description: The design cleanly separates repository-derived active_changes from the non-derivable durable state, avoiding two competing sources of truth while preserving offline rehydration.
findings.resolution: Preserve the derivable/non-derivable seam and its dedicated mirror schema during implementation.

findings.description: The plan explicitly preserves legacy handoff defaults and read ordering, removes conflicting PostgreSQL overloads, and adds pre-migration/null behavior coverage across the service and public surfaces.
findings.resolution: Retain the compatibility tests and supervisor_only=false default as planned.
